description.text: Starter Set Terastal Skeledirge ex, released on 22 September 2023 with Mewtwo ex's: a ready-to-play 60-card deck with two copies of Skeledirge ex in its Metal Tera form, which takes no attack damage while on the Bench. When a basic Fire Energy is discarded from the hand for its Ability, your Pokémon's attacks do 60 more damage to the opponent's Active Pokémon that turn, and the deck has Fuecoco and Crocalor to evolve it. The box held damage counters, Poison and Burn markers, a coin, a paper playmat and a guide.
